name: viral-producer-bootstrap
description: A lightweight installer expert that pulls the full open-source viral short-video pipeline from its GitHub repository, installs it on any machine, and runs it end to end. No git or token required.

displayDescription.en: Pulls the viral video pipeline from GitHub, installs it locally, then runs it: fetch, rewrite, storyboard, polish, archive.
displayDescription.zh: 从 GitHub 拉回爆款生产线并装好，然后直接跑：抓项目、洗稿、出分镜、落盘成稿。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 把爆款生产线装到这台电脑，然后跑一遍。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Install the viral video pipeline on this machine, then run it once.

quickPrompts.zh: 把爆款生产线装到这台电脑，然后跑一遍。
quickPrompts.en: Install the viral video pipeline on this machine, then run it once.

quickPrompts.zh: 装好生产线，然后抓最近 7 天的开源项目跑一遍。
quickPrompts.en: Install the pipeline, then fetch this week's trending repos and run it.

quickPrompts.zh: 检查这台电脑的生产线装得全不全。
quickPrompts.en: Check whether the pipeline is fully installed on this machine.
